scope: Capture settlement/cancellation from exact world-owned offers and private peer-bound escrow, never client item or receipt payloads.
Index both accounts before an unknown intent insertion; retain the first decision, reconcile offer saves and prove both saved escrows before freeze.
Apply and save online or offline participant receipts using existing complete-character journals; completion verifies both actual stored receipts.
Claim complete owned deliveries with bag/Gold and emptied outbox saved together; full bags, overflow and unsupported item formats retain custody.
Strengthen exact retained/claimed receipt proof and reject duplicated ordinary custody; reject nonfinite trade proximity while keeping cancellation available.

checks.recovery: Modeled atomic database receipts with the real BSON filesystem journal: online/offline settlement and cancellation; rejected and lost acknowledgements for intent, first/second character save and completion; fresh journal recovery; sorted opposite-account concurrency; later unrelated Gold preservation; unknown claim saves and local journal failure pinning.
checks.admission: Outsiders, disconnected/distant/different-instance/seated peers, full recipients, negative/overflow wallets, missing/mispaired escrow, wrong identity, duplicate custody and changed offers cannot capture a settlement or alter resources. Cancellation capture works with disconnected/distant/seated peers and full bags.
checks.receipt: Changed retained payload and missing nonempty delivery without a claim revision are rejected; exact retained and properly claimed deliveries replay without a second grant.
checks.correctedDuringWork: Removed an unused math import after extracting finite proximity checks; the final focused race run passed.

remainingBeforeTradePublication: Wire globally sorted both-account command, login/resume, administrator-target and disconnect ownership without nested account locks.
Initialize and drain/recover durable shared intents at startup and discover cold orphan escrow without inventing a competing refund decision.
Connect offer-save acknowledgement, confirmed decision and owned-delivery feedback/retry to actual handlers.
Run bounded integrated handler/restart checks and isolated Mongo index/receipt checks for the final wired source before release.
limits: These tests model atomic database storage; no new actual Mongo/index, socket, native-browser or production-account test was run.
Ordinary direct-trade handlers, startup, login/resume and cleanup are not yet wired to this prepared coordinator. No Alpha 1.73 completion, live publication or whole-economy acceptance is claimed.
Last accepted live release remains Alpha 1.70.1. Metadata stays local until a real release; the persistent full roadmap goal remains active.
